canonical_representation: HEX; RGB is exact. HSL is rounded to one decimal for reference.

foundation.role: Main canvas; ink on bright filled controls.

foundation.name: Deep Space
foundation.role: Panels, cards, navigation and status containers.

foundation.name: Orbit
foundation.role: Raised panels, menus and nested surfaces.

foundation.name: Starlight
foundation.role: Headings, body copy and primary icons on dark.

foundation.name: Dust
foundation.role: Secondary copy, metadata and supporting labels.

foundation.name: Nebula
foundation.role: Primary brand, selected controls and secondary actions.

foundation.name: Aurora
foundation.role: Growth details, bloom accents and focus color on dark.

foundation.name: Sunrise
foundation.role: Main call to action: create a world or send a comet.

utility.name: Nebula 300
utility.role: Default link and selected-text color on dark surfaces.

utility.name: Line
utility.role: Decorative separators only, never a required control boundary.

utility.name: Control Line
utility.role: Visible input and control boundaries on dark surfaces.

semantic.name: Success
semantic.role: Saved, delivered, completed or a healthy system state.

surface.name: Success surface
surface.role: Opaque success message background; precomposed 12% color over Deep Space.

semantic.icon_and_label_rule: Pair the color with a recognizable icon and a visible status label.

semantic.name: Warning
semantic.role: Needs attention; a recoverable limit or unsaved change.

surface.name: Warning surface
surface.role: Opaque warning message background; precomposed 12% color over Deep Space.

semantic.icon_and_label_rule: Pair the color with a recognizable icon and a visible status label.

semantic.name: Danger
semantic.role: Failed action, destructive action or an error that needs repair.

surface.name: Danger surface
surface.role: Opaque danger message background; precomposed 12% color over Deep Space.

semantic.icon_and_label_rule: Pair the color with a recognizable icon and a visible status label.

semantic.name: Info
semantic.role: Neutral guidance, updates and helpful status information.

surface.name: Info surface
surface.role: Opaque info message background; precomposed 12% color over Deep Space.

semantic.icon_and_label_rule: Pair the color with a recognizable icon and a visible status label.

gradient.name: Worldling signature
gradient.use: Large hero artwork, the approved hero mark and short decorative accents. Avoid normal body text and main CTA backgrounds. Use a solid dark surface behind text.

usage.interpretation: A visual-emphasis guide for branded UI, not a literal pixel quota. Planet artwork can have its own world-specific colors. Status colors appear only when needed.

contrast.method: WCAG 2.2 sRGB relative luminance and (Llighter + 0.05)/(Ldarker + 0.05). Threshold decisions use unrounded ratios.
contrast.large_text: At least 24 CSS px regular, or 14pt bold (about 18.67 CSS px).
contrast.limits: These are opaque color-pair results, not a full application conformance claim. Recheck rendered composites over planets, gradients, transparent panels and animated backgrounds.
